response.text:
When buying kurta sets online in India, the right brand depends on what you plan to wear them for—whether it's structured office wear, budget-friendly everyday styles, or premium festive classics.[www.indisangam.com](https://www.indisangam.com/blogs/news/best-kurta-set-brands-in-india#:~:text=Best%20for%3A%20Office%20wear%20and%20coordinated%20kurta,buyers%20may%20like%20it.%20Strong%20office-wear%20appeal.)

Here are the top online brands categorized by what they do best:

### For Office & Workwear

* **W for Woman:** Known for clean, structured cuts, professional colors, and contemporary geometric or subtle prints.[juniperfashion.com](https://juniperfashion.com/blogs/news/top-affordable-ethnic-wear-brands-in-india#:~:text=Their%20mix-and-match%20bottoms%20are%20a%20clever%20idea,minimal%20prints%2C%20professional%20colours%2C%20and%20good%20fabrics.) Their straight kurta sets require very little styling and hold up well through long workdays.[www.indisangam.com](https://www.indisangam.com/blogs/news/best-kurta-set-brands-in-india#:~:text=That%20makes%20it%20useful%20for%20shoppers%20who,kurta%20sets%20with%20a%20more%20structured%20look.)
* **Aurelia:** Focuses on soft pastel shades, breathable cotton, and gentle, feminine shapes that provide all-day comfort.[juniperfashion.com](https://juniperfashion.com/blogs/news/top-affordable-ethnic-wear-brands-in-india#:~:text=If%20you%20are%20a%20working%20woman%20who,also%20works%20well%20for%20different%20body%20types.)

### For Daily Wear & Trendy Styles on a Budget

* **Libas:** A favorite for online shoppers wanting a mix of casual, work, and light festive wear at accessible price points.[www.indisangam.com](https://www.indisangam.com/blogs/news/best-kurta-set-brands-in-india#:~:text=Why%20buyers%20may%20like%20it.%20Strong%20focus,shoppers%20who%20want%20variety%20in%20one%20place.) They update their collections quickly with trendy prints and practical silhouettes.[juniperfashion.com](https://juniperfashion.com/blogs/news/top-affordable-ethnic-wear-brands-in-india#:~:text=Their%20cotton%20kurta%20sets%20provide%20full%20comfort,version%20of%20it%20at%20a%20lower%20price.)

The Libas Floral Embroidered Straight Kurta Set pairs a straight kurta with matching elasticated pants and an embroidered dupatta for **easy festive styling**.

The Libas Embroidered Straight Kurta Set highlights subtle floral embroidery and lace detailing, making it ideal for **light celebrations**.

The Women's Libas Purple Printed Kurta offers a comfortable fit with functional pockets and a **vibrant print** suited for regular outings.

The Libas Peach Embroidered Silk Blend Kurta Set features a silk-blend fabric and palazzo pants to deliver a **dressier festive look**.

The Women's Libas Magenta Woven Design Chanderi Silk Kurta Set uses Chanderi silk with intricate neck embroidery for **rich festive appeal**.

* **Rangriti & Jaipur Kurti:** Excellent budget-friendly options focusing on cotton fabrics, vibrant block prints, and everyday comfort.[juniperfashion.com](https://juniperfashion.com/blogs/news/top-affordable-ethnic-wear-brands-in-india#:~:text=When%20a%20brand%20makes%20its%20own%20clothes%2C,in%20this%20price%20range%20for%20daily%20wear.)

### For Festivals & Family Gatherings

* **Biba:** One of the most established names for traditional and festive wear.[www.indisangam.com](https://www.indisangam.com/blogs/news/best-kurta-set-brands-in-india#:~:text=Coordinated%20ethnic%20sets%20for%20work%20and%20outings.,choice%20for%20festive%20and%20traditional%20kurta%20sets.) They are known for bright colors, classic silhouettes, and versatile mix-and-match bottom options.[juniperfashion.com](https://juniperfashion.com/blogs/news/top-affordable-ethnic-wear-brands-in-india#:~:text=Biba%20has%20been%20around%20since%201988%2C%20so,reliable%20choice.%20*%203.%20W%20for%20Woman.)
* **Soch:** Ideal if you want slightly richer fabrics, deeper festive colors, and heavy detailing for weddings or special occasions.[www.indisangam.com](https://www.indisangam.com/blogs/news/best-kurta-set-brands-in-india#:~:text=Buy%20from%20here%20when%3A%20You%20want%20kurta,Strong%20pick%20for%20occasions%20and%20ethnic%20outings.)

### For Premium Craft & Sustainable Fabrics

* **Fabindia:** Best for pure cotton, silk blends, and traditional hand-block printing techniques like Dabu.

The Fabindia Indigo Cotton Silk Dabu Printed Slim Fit Kurta & Dupatta Set combines a breathable cotton-silk blend with **traditional indigo hand-block patterns**.

The Fabindia Pink Cotton Silk Hand Block Print Dupatta & Kurta Set features a structured Chinese collar and a **smooth sheen** suited for daytime gatherings.

---

### Quick Comparison Table

| Brand | Best For | Fabric Focus | Price Range (Approx.) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **W for Woman** | Structured office wear | Cotton, Viscose blends | ₹900 – ₹3,000 |
| **Libas** | Trendy styles & daily wear | Cotton, Silk blends, Rayon | ₹600 – ₹3,500 |
| **Biba** | Festive classics | Cotton, Liva, Synthetics | ₹1,000 – ₹7,000 |
| **Fabindia** | Premium hand-blocks | Pure Cotton, Silk, Linen | ₹2,500 – ₹8,000+ |
